Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan for the e2e smoke canary update

Planning ref: `main` at `68ac90d017f20613f047c136ea698a47f57c1b85`. The integration branch mismatch line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so this run is not blocked on that.

The file currently holds two lines:
```
status: ok
decompose-run: 41445772297
```

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This is a data-only edit. Replace the whole file content so it is exactly these three lines:
```
status: ok
run_id: alt-42429692819
updated-by: ai-pipeline
```
The existing `decompose-run: 41445772297` line is removed. End the file with one newline after the last line, the usual convention for text files.

## Data structures affected
Only the content of the canary text file. No code, schema or config changes.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Overwrite the whole file instead of editing it line by line
- Chosen: write the whole file with exactly the three lines the issue specifies.
- Alternatives considered: keep the `decompose-run` line and add the new lines below it.
- Why: the issue requires the content to be **exactly** three lines, so the old line has to go.

### D2 — End the file with one newline
- Chosen: a single newline after `updated-by: ai-pipeline`.
- Alternatives considered: no trailing newline.
- Why: this is the standard POSIX text-file convention. The three content lines are still exact either way.

## Security considerations
No trust boundary, endpoint, secret or money surface is involved. The value `alt-42429692819` is a run identifier, not a credential. There is no external input and no realistic way to abuse this change.

## Potential risks or edge cases
- If a smoke check compares the file byte for byte and was built expecting no trailing newline, it could fail. The risk is low, and D2 records the assumption.
- Scope lock: only this one file may change. That means no changelog entry and no `agents.d` fragment.
- No conflicts were found between the issue and the codebase: the file exists, as the issue says.

## Testing considerations
- Check the result with `cat tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`: it should print exactly the three lines.
- Check that `git diff --stat` shows `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` and nothing else.
- No new tests are needed.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt

Layers 1 and 2 of the reuse audit don't apply, because there is no helper or pattern to reuse for a static text edit; the change simply updates the existing canary file. The complete option and the shortcut are the same change, so the Boil the Lake check is met. §6 priorities (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed) favour matching the specified content exactly and touching nothing else.
